notes: Five prompts should route to this skill and five are adjacent but out of scope, so both over-triggering and under-triggering are measurable.
Each probe runs with read-only tools in an empty directory. The routing decision is made from the description before any file is read, so the absence of a real repository does not affect it.
A probe is correct when the skill fired and was expected to, or did not fire and was not expected to.

prompts.prompt: Add a release workflow that publishes the package to npm when a version tag is pushed.
Review the permissions block in .github/workflows/deploy.yml and tell me if it grants too much.
Pin every action we use to a commit SHA instead of a version tag.
Add a dependabot configuration that keeps our GitHub Actions up to date weekly.
One of our workflows echoes the pull request title inside a run block. Is that safe, and fix it if not.
Our GitLab CI pipeline needs a caching stage so the dependency install stops repeating.
Add a Jenkinsfile stage that runs the integration tests against a staging database.
The Dockerfile in this repo runs the application as root. Fix that.
Write a bash script that tags a release, signs the tag, and pushes it to the remote.
Explain what OIDC is and why it is preferred over long-lived cloud credentials.
